cues.en: Welcome back.
cues.zh: 歡迎回來。

cues.en: Whenever you start to learn Python, it's unavoidable that you'll encounter this topic of Python two versus Python three.
cues.zh: 開始學 Python，難免會遇到 Python 2 和 Python 3 的比較。

cues.en: So what is this all about?
cues.zh: 這到底是怎麼回事？

cues.en: And it's a very important topic.
cues.zh: 這是很重要的主題。

cues.en: Now, first of all, Python is created by a human right.
cues.zh: 首先，Python 是人創造的，對吧？

cues.en: As a matter of fact, it was created by this person right here.
cues.zh: 事實上，就是這位創造的。

cues.en: His name is Guido.
cues.zh: 他的名字是 Guido。

cues.en: Now, a programming language is always evolving.
cues.zh: 程式語言會持續演進。

cues.en: It's not like somebody creates a programming language.
cues.zh: 不是有人創造出一種語言，

cues.en: It's perfect and that's it.
cues.zh: 它就完美無缺，從此不變。

cues.en: No, all programming languages are constantly being updated.
cues.zh: 不是，所有程式語言都在持續更新。

cues.en: Just like on your phone, you constantly get software updates.
cues.zh: 就像手機會不斷收到軟體更新。

cues.en: Well, a programming language is constantly evolving to make it better and better because nobody gets it right the first time.
cues.zh: 程式語言也會持續演進、越來越好，因為沒有人第一次就能全做對。

cues.en: And by the way, this is a great video that I'm going to link to.
cues.zh: 順帶一提，我會提供這支很棒的影片連結。

cues.en: You can check it out in the resources.
cues.zh: 可以到資源區查看。

cues.en: Now, Python was created in 1991 by this gentleman and it was actually created with the name from Monty Python, which was a British comedy group.
cues.zh: Python 是這位先生在 1991 年創造的，名稱來自英國喜劇團體 Monty Python。

cues.en: But like I said before, the language is always evolving.
cues.zh: 但如剛才所說，語言會不斷演進。

cues.en: And in 2008, Guido decided that, well, Python version two, which has been used for a very long time,
cues.zh: 到了 2008 年，Guido 決定，使用已久的 Python 2，

cues.en: had some things that he and the community wanted to change.
cues.zh: 有些地方是他和社群想改的。

cues.en: So in 2008, they decided to create Python three, a new version of the language.
cues.zh: 所以在 2008 年，他們決定建立語言的新版本 Python 3。

cues.en: Here was the tricky part.
cues.zh: 麻煩的地方來了。

cues.en: You see, when you update software, let's say on your phone or even on your laptop, you expect things to keep working, right?
cues.zh: 更新軟體時，例如手機或筆電的軟體，你會期待原有功能繼續正常運作，對吧？

cues.en: Updates are usually good.
cues.zh: 更新通常是好事。

cues.en: They're improvements.
cues.zh: 代表有所改善。

cues.en: But some of the features that Python two had, they didn't like or they wanted to change completely.
cues.zh: 但 Python 2 的某些功能，他們不喜歡，或者想徹底改掉。

cues.en: So Python three introduced what we call breaking changes.
cues.zh: 因此 Python 3 引入了所謂的不相容變更。

cues.en: That is if you updated to Python three, remember the python interpreter, the c python translator that we've been talking about?
cues.zh: 也就是說，如果更新到 Python 3；還記得前面說的 Python 直譯器、CPython 翻譯工具嗎？

cues.en: Well, as soon as you updated that your Python two code wasn't really going to work.
cues.zh: 一旦更新，那些 Python 2 程式碼，就可能無法運作。

cues.en: It's like updating your phone and then all of a sudden all your apps stop working.
cues.zh: 就像更新手機後，突然所有應用程式都不能用了。

cues.en: That doesn't sound very good, does it?
cues.zh: 聽起來不太好，對吧？

cues.en: That's pretty much what happened in 2008.
cues.zh: 2008 年的情況大致如此。

cues.en: Most companies that wrote their code in Python version two just kept Python version two because, well,
cues.zh: 多數用 Python 2 寫程式的公司，就繼續使用 Python 2，因為

cues.en: for them to upgrade meant that they had to go through their code line by line and make some changes.
cues.zh: 升級代表得逐行檢查程式，做一些修改。

cues.en: Now, these changes weren't that significant.
cues.zh: 其實變動本身沒有那麼大。

cues.en: For example, I'll link to some resources, but don't worry, these are topics that we're going to cover throughout the course, but different things wouldn't work.
cues.zh: 我會提供資源連結。別擔心，這些主題整門課都會談到，只是某些寫法會無法執行。

cues.en: For example, the print function which we've learned about in Python two, it didn't have the brackets.
cues.zh: 例如我們學過的 print，在 Python 2 裡，原本不加圓括號。

cues.en: It looked like this and Python three.
cues.zh: 它是這樣寫；而 Python 3

cues.en: Used the brackets.
cues.zh: 使用圓括號。

cues.en: So all the code that had print like this would break.
cues.zh: 所以，原本這種 print 寫法都會失效。

cues.en: Now, the differences themselves aren't that big.
cues.zh: 差異本身其實不算很大。

cues.en: I mean, you can read through them and we'll talk about this in the course, but overall, you can learn them in a day.
cues.zh: 可以讀一讀，我們課程裡也會談，整體來說，一天就能了解。

cues.en: That's why when we learn Python, most of the time we're learning Python three.
cues.zh: 因此學 Python 時，多數時候學的是 Python 3。

cues.en: But you can use the same knowledge with the older version of Python.
cues.zh: 但同樣的知識，也能用在較舊的 Python 版本。

cues.en: Now you may see some Python version to code out there for companies that haven't upgraded, but it's now what we call legacy.
cues.zh: 你可能仍會在尚未升級的公司看到 Python 2 程式，但現在稱為 legacy，也就是舊有程式。

cues.en: That is come 2020, it's going to stop receiving security updates.
cues.zh: 依這段課程當時的說明，到了 2020 年，它就會停止接收安全性更新。

cues.en: So the community Python community as a whole is saying, Hey, everybody, start using Python three because we're going to stop maintaining Python two.
cues.zh: 所以整個 Python 社群都在說：「大家開始用 Python 3 吧，因為我們要停止維護 Python 2 了。」

cues.en: So we're going to learn the most up to date version three in this course.
cues.zh: 因此，這門課會學當時最新的 Python 3。

cues.en: But we're also going to touch on some older topics that Python two covers just in case you encounter them when you work for a company that perhaps still supports legacy code.
cues.zh: 也會接觸一些 Python 2 的舊觀念，以防你在仍支援舊有程式的公司工作時遇到。

cues.en: But as I mentioned, the whole community as a whole is moving towards Python three.
cues.zh: 但如剛才所說，整體社群都在往 Python 3 移動。

cues.en: This website, for example, shows you how many big packages, popular Python packages, which we'll talk about support Python three.
cues.zh: 例如，這個網站顯示，稍後會介紹的熱門大型 Python 套件，有多少支援 Python 3。

cues.en: In our case, there's only four popular packages that don't support Python three.
cues.zh: 當時畫面上，只有四個熱門套件不支援 Python 3。

cues.en: So what I'm saying is Python three is the way to go.
cues.zh: 所以我的意思是，Python 3 是應該採用的方向。

cues.en: It's the way of the future.
cues.zh: 它代表未來。

cues.en: That's what we're going to learn in the course.
cues.zh: 這就是課程要學的版本。

cues.en: But I want you to be aware of the historical context.
cues.zh: 但我希望你知道這段歷史背景。

cues.en: And one thing to be careful of when in this course you're searching for answers, or maybe I have some exercises that require you to Google things.
cues.zh: 還有一點要注意，課程裡搜尋答案，或某些練習要求你上 Google 查資料時，

cues.zh: 語言功能的參考資料，會看到

cues.zh: 這裡可以選版本。通常要用最新版本，但網路上一些答案可能還使用 Python 2。

cues.en: So you want to make sure that when you're searching for answers, that you don't encounter any legacy code.
cues.zh: 所以搜尋答案時，要留意不要誤用了舊版程式碼。

cues.en: Like I said, 95% of the time it's mostly the same.
cues.zh: 如剛才所說，95% 的情況大致相同。

cues.en: But you usually want to keep current with the language.
cues.zh: 但通常還是應該跟上語言的現行版本。

cues.en: It has the most community support, most up to date, most secure language.
cues.zh: 它有最多社群支援、更新的功能，也有較新的安全維護。

cues.en: So just a quick note about Python three versus Python two.
cues.zh: 這就是 Python 3 和 Python 2 的簡短說明。

cues.en: When you hear the word python, people are generally just talking about both Python three and Python two.
cues.zh: 聽到 Python 這個名稱，通常可能同時涵蓋 Python 3 與 Python 2。
